answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 20743 Country: India Title: I live at Malerkotla Punjab. My question is that is the KFC chicken is Halal Or Haram. When we go to purchase at KFC Ludhiana i ask about the Chicken. They answered me that the chicken is Halal. I saw some other Muslims are purchasing too. But i am in doubt because a person tell me that the KFC chicken is not Halal they use JHATKA chicken. So i want to know that what is the write answer .Can i eat or not. 2. My 2nd question is that i drink pork in my dreams in regular two days. I want to the meaning of this dream. Jazakallah Question: Asslamualaikum Mufti Sahib. I live at Malerkotla Punjab. My question is that is the KFC chicken is Halal Or Haram. When we go to purchase at KFC Ludhiana i ask about the Chicken. They answered me that the chicken is Halal. I saw some other Muslims are purchasing too. But i am in doubt because a person tell me that the KFC chicken is not Halal they use JHATKA chicken. So i want to know that what is the write answer .Can i eat or not. 2. My 2nd question is that i drink pork in my dreams in regular two days. I want to the meaning of this dream. Jazakallah Answer ID: 20743 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 380/380/M=1431) (1) One should refrain from the things which are doubtful. If KFC chicken is slaughtered according to Islamic rules it would be lawful, otherwise not. One should avoid purchasing and consuming it until there is no certainty or strong presumption of being halal. (2) Backbiting of any Muslim is like eating the flesh of dead brother. You should lock you tongue from backbiting. The dream indicates towards it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
